Definition: Aner, a Amorite, also a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Aner is one of the Amorite chiefs who joined Abram in the rescue of Lot, and the name also belongs to a town of Manasseh given to the Levites. Genesis remembers him as Abram's ally, and the chronicler remembers the town that bore his name.
TheologicalSignificance: A minor ally in Abram's war still earns a place in the record, and I take that as God's way: the men who stand beside His people in a hard hour are not forgotten, even if their own story is only a line.
